annotations.text:
Mbele redesign — one system, eleven artboards.

Top row: the foundations. Middle row: the mobile journey, left to right — discover, navigate, search, browse, understand, check, save. Bottom row: desktop and the states every screen needs.

Every colour, type step, radius and breakpoint comes from the real tokens.css. Sample opportunity names are placeholders.

The masthead is 270px, not a full-screen hero. UX_FLOWS §2 requires the board to start high and forbids a marketing hero — this gives a first-time visitor one sentence and a search box without pushing the live list below the fold.

CORRECTION. I first reported there was no bottom navigation. That was true of the commit I audited and wrong by the time you asked: PrimaryNav.astro shipped the evening before, deliberately, because DESIGN SYSTEM.md §5.7 specifies a five-item bottom bar — and the same paragraph bans the hamburger that replaces it.

So removing it is a spec decision, not a styling one. Both options are drawn on the artboard beside this note.
The facts keep their labels but lose the bordered cells. That grid is what made a row read as a database. Four borders per row removed, on a page of thirty rows.
